title: Mazi: a place for your shared memories
question: Choose the experience to develop. All imagery and memory details are synthetic examples.

options.label: The Screening Room
options.lineage: Friends gathering around a projected holiday slide
options.thesis: A shallow 3D arrangement of memories brings one shared moment into focus.
options.viewport: Stable top navigation; one large front-facing photograph, two receding neighbors, a quiet title and Open memory control.
options.risk: Atmosphere must not make browsing feel slow or require camera skills.

raised.raise: Use one consistent alignment for titles, dates and selection.
Group simultaneous contributions visibly within one event.
Retain a visible way back and neighboring-memory context.
Give counts, memory order and source credits deliberate typography.
Keep navigation stable and show only one active layer.

options.label: The Living Album
options.lineage: Editorial travel journals and the album passed around a table
options.thesis: A generous photographic spread with a tactile 3D stack that opens into the memory.
options.viewport: Editorial title on the left, a dominant photo stack on the right, and an ordered strip of other memories below.
options.risk: The album metaphor is familiar; composition and the opening transition must earn the bespoke feel.

options.label: The Memory Rail
options.thesis: A calibrated date rail anchors open photograph plates.
options.viewport: An off-center rail aligns dates beneath a photo.
options.risk: Line encodings feel analytical and require learning.
options.case: Loses audience identification and clarity for casual rediscovery.
options.kept: Use one consistent alignment for titles, dates and selection.

options.label: The Shared Score
options.thesis: Parallel columns show contributions to the same event.
options.viewport: An upward chronological staff with images alongside.
options.risk: Upward time and encoded blocks are unfamiliar.
options.case: Loses audience identification and clarity by adding a notation language.
options.kept: Group simultaneous contributions visibly within one event.

options.label: The Everyday Collection
options.thesis: Comfortable photo cards make everyday browsing immediately familiar.
options.viewport: One featured photo card above smaller memories and labeled navigation.
options.risk: Welcoming, but less distinctive; depth lives inside the featured stack.
options.case: Holds product clarity; loses the Screening Room’s distinctive shared ritual.

options.label: Journeys Together
options.thesis: Events become stops along the group’s shared history.
options.viewport: An event corridor beside the selected photo.
options.risk: Routes can imply relationships the archive does not establish.
options.case: Loses audience identification and clarity for ordinary moments without journeys.
options.kept: Retain a visible way back and neighboring-memory context.

options.label: The Memory Mixtape
options.thesis: A titled cover opens into an ordered list of moments.
options.viewport: A folded cover, numbered list and selected photograph.
options.risk: Audio cues and side A/B suggest the wrong product.
options.case: Loses audience identification and clarity through arbitrary content halves.
options.kept: Give counts, memory order and source credits deliberate typography.

options.label: The Tabbed Archive
options.thesis: Stable section tabs reveal layered photos and source context.
options.viewport: Stepped tabs beside a photo and its context leaf.
options.case: Loses audience identification and clarity through unnecessary hierarchy.
options.kept: Keep navigation stable and show only one active layer.

canonCard.label: The familiar photo library
canonCard.thesis: A chronological photo grid with conventional album navigation.
canonCard.viewport: Home navigation, a featured memory, and a clean chronological grid.
canonCard.risk: Efficient, but gives up much of the spatial identity you asked to explore.
